system.description: A funeral bell tolls from beneath the earth in a 20' radius at a point within 60'.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and every Undead within 60' is drawn 10' toward the bell.
outcomes.success: Every creature in the area takes d6 damage and is Deafened for d6 rounds. Undead in the area are drawn 10' toward its centre.
outcomes.ruin: The bell tolls for you: every Undead within 60' is drawn 10' toward you. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
